objections.objection: We already have an in-house team building automation on top of Astreya — why buy external?
objections.counterResponse: Our connector took an 18-month, 6-person engineering effort. We can deploy it in your environment in 2 weeks. Your team's time is far more valuable spent on clinical innovation than HIS plumbing. We can show you a detailed build vs. buy analysis.

objections.objection: Patient data cannot leave our on-premise environment — cloud SaaS is a non-starter for us.
objections.counterResponse: We support fully air-gapped on-premise deployment. Three of our current clients operate under the same compliance posture. We can share our security architecture document and arrange a call with our CISO today.

objections.objection: We had a failed automation pilot with a vendor 18 months ago — the board is skeptical of another attempt.
objections.counterResponse: We've specifically studied those failure patterns. Our pilot structure is designed to produce measurable, verifiable results in 30 days — not 6 months. We structure the PoC with outcome-based pricing so we absorb the delivery risk, not you.

objections.objection: Our budget cycle ends in Q3 and procurement takes a minimum of 4 months.
objections.counterResponse: Our zero-cost 30-day PoC does not require any procurement approval. Once the results are proven at one hospital, formal procurement runs in parallel with the extended pilot, so you're not blocked.

topRisks: Internal build team may resist an external vendor solution as a threat to their roadmap
Astreya API rate limits and undocumented endpoints may extend the 2-week integration estimate
